title: Board Selection Reconcile And Escape
description: Fix selection-exit secondary highlight not visible: JSX syncBoardScene overwrote object.selected vs WASM selectionIds. Reconcile selected flags after scene sync. Add Escape: cancel in-flight area select (restore initial_ids) or restore previous selection snapshot; clear exit highlight on restore.
summary: Root cause: syncBoardScene applied JSX selected props and overwrote WASM-driven selectionIds on scene objects, so Rust still painted primary selected chrome and never exit-secondary. Added BoardRenderer.reconcileSceneSelectedWithSelectionIds() after syncBoardScene. Tracked selectionPreviousForEscape on each committed merge for one-step undo: Escape cancels in-flight area select via new WASM cancelAreaSelect (restores initial_ids) or restores the previous selection and clears exit highlights. Rust test board_host_cancel_area_select_restores_initial_selection.
